court: Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit

issues.label: CFC Tucker Act jurisdiction
issues.why: Court must confirm a money-mandating source supports disability retirement pay claims.

issues.label: Money-mandating statute identified
issues.why: Court must determine whether applicable military disability retirement statutes mandate payment if entitlement is shown.

issues.label: APA-style review standard
issues.why: Court must apply the proper deferential standard for BCNR decisions (arbitrary/capricious, contrary to law, unsupported by substantial evidence).

issues.label: Record review scope
issues.why: Court must decide what materials comprise the administrative record and whether supplementation is permitted.

issues.label: Exhaustion of remedies
issues.why: Court must ensure plaintiff properly pursued BCNR correction before suing (or determine exhaustion is excused).

issues.label: Statute of limitations accrual
issues.why: Court must determine when the disability retirement claim first accrued for 28 U.S.C. § 2501 purposes.

issues.label: Six-year time bar applicability
issues.why: Court must decide whether § 2501 bars the claim and whether any doctrine affects timeliness.

issues.label: Accrual suspension doctrine
issues.why: Court must consider if accrual was suspended due to inherently unknowable facts or government concealment.

issues.label: BCNR reconsideration effect
issues.why: Court must decide whether the 2023 BCNR decision restarts accrual or merely reconsidered a stale claim.

issues.label: Remand tolling effect
issues.why: Court must determine whether voluntary remand proceedings affect limitations or jurisdictional timing.

issues.label: Claim-splitting/issue preclusion
issues.why: Court must consider whether prior BCNR/CFC actions limit the issues or claims now presented.

issues.label: Proper defendant and relief
issues.why: Court must ensure relief sought is against the United States and within CFC’s remedial power.

issues.label: Non-monetary relief limits
issues.why: Court must decide whether DD-214 correction is allowable as incidental to a money judgment.

issues.label: Justiciability of military decisions
issues.why: Court must confirm the disability/fitness determination is reviewable and not committed wholly to discretion.

issues.label: Presumption of fitness doctrine
issues.why: Court must apply the presumption that continued performance of duty indicates fitness absent clear evidence.

issues.label: Correct fitness legal test
issues.why: Court must determine whether BCNR used the proper standard for “unfit for continued naval service” at separation.

issues.label: Fitness at time of separation
issues.why: Court must assess whether evidence supports fitness/unfitness specifically as of April 1, 2013.

issues.label: Causation nexus to duty
issues.why: Court must determine whether PTSD/TBI caused inability to perform duties, not merely existed or was service-connected.

issues.label: Performance vs diagnosis distinction
issues.why: Court must consider that a diagnosis alone does not establish unfitness without functional impairment impacting duty.

issues.label: Effect of promotion/assignment
issues.why: Court must evaluate how promotion, MOS change, and instructor assignment bear on fitness determination.

issues.label: Limited duty significance
issues.why: Court must consider whether prior limited duty reflects unfitness or resolved/managed impairment by discharge.

issues.label: Medical board referral duty
issues.why: Court must decide whether regulations required MEB/PEB referral before VSP separation given known conditions.

issues.label: Procedural error prejudice
issues.why: Court must assess whether any failure to convene MEB/PEB was harmful and would likely change outcome.

issues.label: VSP separation interaction
issues.why: Court must analyze how voluntary force-shaping separation affects entitlement to disability processing/retirement.

issues.label: Line-of-duty and service connection
issues.why: Court must confirm injuries were incurred in line of duty and not barred by misconduct or other exclusions.

issues.label: Disability rating threshold
issues.why: Court must determine whether conditions would have been rated at least 30% under DoD/VASRD for retirement.

issues.label: DoD vs VA rating differences
issues.why: Court must decide what weight to give VA’s 100%/70% ratings given different standards and timing.

issues.label: Use of post-discharge evidence
issues.why: Court must decide whether and how post-separation medical evidence can illuminate condition at separation.

issues.label: Weight of contemporaneous records
issues.why: Court must evaluate whether contemporaneous service records outweigh later diagnoses/assessments.

issues.label: Combat-related PTSD/TBI evidence
issues.why: Court must consider the significance of documented combat trauma and TBI in evaluating fitness and liberal consideration.

issues.label: Liberal consideration requirement
issues.why: Court must decide whether 10 U.S.C. § 1552(h) and implementing guidance required liberal consideration here.

issues.label: Scope of liberal consideration
issues.why: Court must define what liberal consideration entails for PTSD/TBI claims (evidentiary inferences, mitigation, causation).

issues.label: BCNR compliance with policy
issues.why: Court must determine whether BCNR actually applied required PTSD/TBI liberal consideration even if not explicit.

issues.label: Adequacy of BCNR explanation
issues.why: Court must decide whether BCNR provided a rational connection between facts found and conclusion of fitness.

issues.label: Consideration of all evidence
issues.why: Court must determine whether BCNR ignored material evidence or failed to address key arguments.

issues.label: Medical advisory opinion use
issues.why: Court must assess whether any medical opinions relied upon were competent, current, and adequately explained.

issues.label: Reliance on non-medical factors
issues.why: Court must determine whether BCNR improperly relied on administrative facts (VSP, duty status) over medical evidence.

issues.label: Burden of proof allocation
issues.why: Court must decide who bears the burden before BCNR/CFC and whether BCNR applied “preponderance” correctly.

issues.label: Standard of proof consistency
issues.why: Court must ensure BCNR’s “preponderance” approach aligns with governing correction-board standards.

issues.label: Regulatory framework applied
issues.why: Court must confirm BCNR applied correct Navy/DoD disability evaluation regulations in effect at separation.

issues.label: Error vs injustice standard
issues.why: Court must decide whether BCNR properly considered both “error” and “injustice” bases for correction.

issues.label: Constructive disability retirement
issues.why: Court must determine whether plaintiff can obtain back pay via constructive placement on the disability retired list.

issues.label: Remedy calculation period
issues.why: Court must decide from what date disability retired pay would run and what offsets apply.

issues.label: Offsets and recoupment issues
issues.why: Court must consider interaction between military retired pay, VA compensation, and any required offsets.

issues.label: Eligibility for CRDP/CRSC
issues.why: Court must consider whether correction would affect concurrent receipt entitlements, even if not directly awarded here.

issues.label: Interest and attorney fees
issues.why: Court must determine whether any interest is barred and whether EAJA or other fee statutes could apply.

issues.label: Proper form of judgment
issues.why: Court must decide whether to remand to BCNR, order correction, or enter monetary judgment based on record.

issues.label: Remand standard and scope
issues.why: Court must determine when remand is appropriate for inadequate reasoning versus deciding merits directly.

issues.label: Deference to military expertise
issues.why: Court must calibrate deference to BCNR’s military judgment while enforcing legal and procedural requirements.

issues.label: Harmless error doctrine
issues.why: Court must assess whether any legal/policy misstep (e.g., liberal consideration) was outcome-determinative.

issues.label: Finality of agency action
issues.why: Court must confirm the 2023 BCNR decision is final agency action suitable for judicial review.

issues.label: Standing and injury
issues.why: Court must ensure plaintiff has a concrete monetary injury traceable to BCNR denial and redressable by judgment.
